FR-001.title: User-visible remembered confirmation only after remember_fact returns ok true in the same turn

FR-002.title: User-visible forgotten confirmation only after forget_fact returns ok true in the same turn

FR-003.title: Enforce earned confirmations on the turn path that produces the user-visible reply

FR-004.title: Confirmation keys off tool ok payload, not Python-level non-exception

FR-005.title: No ungated companion reply path for remembered/forgotten confirmations

FR-006.title: Forget matching prefers precision over recall; miss returns ok false

FR-007.title: Forget must not retract on short substring or batch of merely similar facts

FR-008.title: Forget still retracts a clearly identified predicate or value

FR-009.title: Hard-cut eval criteria that reward unearned I'll remember wording

FR-010.title: Do not implement P5 veto, hard classifier, specialist catalogs, memories FS, or 140-142 rewrites

context: constraint: Principle VIII no shim no dual door
constraint: confirm only after remember_fact/forget_fact ok
constraint: out of scope P5 hard classifier specialist catalogs memories FS 140-142 rewrites
intent: Earn remembered/forgotten confirmations on the turn path and make forget matching precise so Ze does not lie or retract the wrong facts.
expectations: specialist catalog rewrites / specialist prompt constitution
eval memory_proposals_count hard-cut (roadmap, not this phase)
approach: Companion buffers token_sink, gates AgentResult.response on remember_fact/forget_fact ok, and hard-cuts tool-free stream. Forget matching is a precision ladder in _retract_facts_matching (exact, named value, long phrase, unique high cosine) — substring and top-5 cosine are deleted.

decisions.decision: Gate in ze-personal with buffered token_sink; rewrite CompanionAgent.stream
decisions.why: agentic_loop streams unearned text before run can rewrite; stream() is a tool-free dual door
decisions.rejected: prompt-only fix; gate only AgentResult.response; dialect inside BaseAgent.agentic_loop

decisions.decision: Earned iff tool payload ok is true
decisions.why: tools return ok false without raising

decisions.decision: Deterministic sentence strip plus fallback copy; no LLM judge
Forget ladder: exact then named value in query then long phrase then unique cosine 0.88/0.80 gap
decisions.why: precision over recall; current substring and top-5 0.75 over-forget
decisions.rejected: exact-only; keep 0.75 top-5 behind a flag; SQL ILIKE

plan.summary: Turn-path confirmation gate plus precision forget matcher; no shims
plan.key_finding: token_sink streams the lie before CompanionAgent.run returns

tasks.summary: 16 tasks: setup, honesty stub, US1 gate+sink+stream+eval, US2 matcher, polish+tests
